messages:
elaine: Quick sync — SlateBurst dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PST. Need confirmation on quota slices, autoscale thresholds, and smoke load test window. Also we should capture any enablement notes for their renewal discussion.
Sam Ops: Confirm pool: 2 x A100-equivalent nodes reserved, steady quota 120k tokens/min, burst to 240k tokens/min for up to 5m. @Jin will we have cushion slots for failover?
Jin: Yup — we'll reserve 10% cushion slots (hot spares). Autoscaler will scale from min_replicas:2 -> max_replicas:6. Canary window 3m. Also adding a graceful-fallback route to hosted fallback if regional capacity low.
Diego: For the load profile, recommend ramp pattern: 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 15m then 30m steady then ramp down. We'll use model v1.3-quant for cost; monitor quality regressions with our eval set.
Karen: From PS side — customer asked for a quiet warmup (no external rate spikes) because their compliance team wants stable latency baseline for go/no-go. Capture that as enablement item and in the renewal risk notes.
Sam Ops: Load test command (we'll run from n1 with k6):
```
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 45m --env TARGET=https://api.redwood.io/v1/generate --iterations 100000
```
Make sure secrets and keys rotated for test account.
Jin: Autoscaler config snippet:
```
scaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 6
  target_cpu_utilization: 60
  scale_up_cooldown: 30s
  scale_down_cooldown: 120s
```
Also enabling prefix cache priming before test to avoid cold starts.
capacity-bot: Reserved pool allocated: pool_id=sltb-6276, nodes=2, cushion=10% :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v1.3-quant started at 09:15 PST — health checks green :rocket:
elaine: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Sam/Jin run smoke test 09:30-10:15 PST, (2) Diego collect eval diffs and flag if >1% quality drop, (3) Karen note quiet-warmup request in renewal notes. I'll post a one-pager for customer ops after tests.
Diego: Will capture eval diffs and upload to the shared drive, pinging @elaine when done.
Sam Ops: I'll trigger k6 and share the log snippet once done.
